column1: # Stage 3 excision manifest, rebased on 2801280b with a binary-rooted dead_code probe.
# rule ABSENT: no declaration may remain (not even under cfg(test)).
#      NOT_PRODUCTION: thin wrapper over a live kernel; may survive only as a #[cfg(test)] harness.
#      REACH: generic name / field / variant; enforced only by the binary-rooted reachability probe.
#      RETAINED: Windows-held (constructed or used only under cfg(windows), e.g. StateWriteIntent::CoordinatorConptyShim
#                by coordinator/conpty_shim.rs) or live-kernel review item; not required.
# check file: the declaration is looked up in its own file; crate: the name was declared only there at BASE,
#       so it must not reappear anywhere under src/ (no relocation).
